title: The MFA enrolment gate
caption: PF-04 AC4. An owner or admin of a live OTA without MFA sees only this page.

steps.title: Sign in without MFA
steps.expect: Redirect to `/mfa-enrolment?next=/dashboard` ("Set up two-factor authentication"); no navigation shell.

steps.title: Enrol
steps.body: Scan the QR code, type a code, store the ten recovery codes, **Continue**.
steps.expect: The asked-for page renders; opening `/mfa-enrolment` again leads straight on.

steps.title: Agents are never asked
steps.expect: Normal dashboard; the gate is only for owners and admins.
